description: 2022 BMW 228i Gran Coupe M Sport For Sale in "Snapper Rocks Blue Metallic!"  M Sport Package  Oyster/Black Interior  Panoramic Roof  Live Cockpit Pro  53K Miles  WE FINANCE   This is what happens when somebody actually checks the right boxes on a 228i.  Finished in Snapper Rocks Blue Metallic over Oyster/Black, this 2022 BMW 228i Gran Coupe has 53K miles and a factory specification that makes it considerably more interesting than the average example.  The big one is the M Sport Package, bringing the M Sport bodywork, suspension, steering, Shadowline treatment and 18-inch M wheels. Add the Convenience Package, panoramic moonroof, Live Cockpit Professional with Navigation, heated seats and steering wheel, Extended Shadowline Trim and remote start, and this one was ordered extremely well.  But let's be honestthe first thing you'll notice is the color.   Snapper Rocks Blue + M Sport.  Snapper Rocks Blue Metallic is exactly the kind of color that works on a BMW.  Bright enough to stand out without becoming obnoxious, and paired with the M Sport aerodynamic treatment and Extended Shadowline Trim, it gives this 228i a completely different presence than the typical black, white or gray commuter-spec car.  The Oyster/Black interior is an equally good choice. It gives the cabin some contrast without going overboard, while the M steering wheel, Illuminated Nizza trim and panoramic roof make the interior feel considerably more special.  And the M Sport Package isn't just cosmetic. It also brings M Sport suspension, M Sport steering and the 8-speed Sport Automatic transmission, along with the 18-inch Style 819M wheels and more aggressive aerodynamic package. Between Snapper Rocks Blue, the M Sport Package, Shadowline trim and 18-inch M wheels, the exterior has the aggressive BMW appearance you want. Inside, Oyster/Black breaks up the typical all-black cabin while the panoramic roof, heated equipment, Navigation and Convenience Package cover the amenities you'll actually use.  It's a lot of the look and equipment people want from a modern BMW, wrapped into a package that remains approachable to own and enjoy.   Texas Hot Rides has specialized in enthusiast, performance and specialty vehicles in the Dallas-Fort Worth area since 2009, and not everything interesting has to make 700 horsepower. Sometimes it's simply about finding the everyday car in the specification you don't see every day. A 2022 BMW 228i Gran Coupe in Snapper Rocks Blue with the M Sport Package and Oyster/Black interior fits that description perfectly.  Snapper Rocks Blue. Oyster interior. M Sport.
